title: Jushin Liger vs. Naoki Sano
summary: Liger’s first championship reign meets its defining early rival in Naoki Sano. The struggle forces the new masked star to recover from defeat and establish himself as the junior division’s leading figure.

chapters.title: Sano ends Liger’s first reign
chapters.result: Naoki Sano defeats Liger for the IWGP junior title.
chapters.context: The loss follows an earlier inconclusive defense, making Sano a sustained obstacle rather than a one-night challenger.

chapters.title: Liger regains the championship
chapters.result: Liger defeats Sano to win the title back.
chapters.context: After earning the opportunity through a contender tournament, Liger answers his most difficult early rival and begins another reign.
